Our story

## We built Close because we needed it ourselves.

Before Close was a CRM, we were a sales team.

After Y Combinator, our founders started ElasticSales and did outbound sales for other startups. They spent their days calling, emailing, demoing, and following up with thousands of leads.

They tried plenty of CRMs. Most were better at keeping track of sales than helping the team actually sell.

So they built their own.

Other startups started asking if they could use it too.

In 2013, that internal tool became Close.

![Close founders on Sand Hill Road in the early days of Close](https://close.com/assets/images/about-founders-sand-hill.webp)

_The early days: Steli, Anthony, and Thomas on Sand Hill Road._

We’re still building Close for the people doing the selling, with automation and AI helping them respond faster, follow up consistently, and close more deals.

Who uses Close

## Built for businesses where conversations drive revenue.

If winning a customer means actually talking to them and staying on top of the follow-up, Close was built for the way you sell.

-

### Founders & business owners

Selling is one of your many jobs. You need to keep track of leads and follow up without becoming a CRM administrator.

-

### Sales teams

Your reps sell through calls, email, and SMS. They need one place to manage their leads and see the full conversation.

-

### High-volume sellers

You’re working hundreds or thousands of leads and need automation without losing track of the conversation.

### Your sales stack gets smaller

Communication, automation, reporting, and AI are already built in. For many teams, that means fewer tools to buy, connect, and maintain. Everything else connects through [Close integrations](https://close.com/integrations) and the [Close MCP server](https://close.com/integrations/close-mcp).

-
### Built for sales. Built to move fast.

Close is purpose-built for sales teams, without the complexity of an enterprise CRM.

-
### AI already has the backstory

Calls, emails, texts, meetings, notes, and sales activity are already in Close. That gives Chloe and Agents context about what's happened with a lead without relying on someone to keep every field perfectly updated.

### Independent and profitable.

Close is self-funded and profitable. We've been building Close for more than a decade without outside investors.

We answer to our customers. We like it that way.

## Frequently asked questions

#What is Close?

Close is a sales CRM built for small businesses that sell through conversations. It brings calling, email, SMS, pipeline management, automation, reporting, and AI together in one place.

#Is Close a good CRM for small businesses?

Yes. Close is built for small businesses, founders, and small sales teams that need powerful sales tools without a complicated sales stack. It’s especially well suited to businesses where conversations and consistent follow-up drive revenue.

#Who is Close best for?

Close is best for businesses with an active sales process where people win customers through calls, emails, texts, meetings, and consistent follow-up. That includes founders selling themselves, small sales teams, and high-volume sellers across industries like financial services, recruiting, agencies, consulting, SaaS, and insurance.

#How is Close different from other CRMs?

Close is built specifically for small sales teams, but the differences depend on what you’re comparing it to. Compared with broader platforms like HubSpot and Salesforce, Close is more focused on the sales process and requires less software and administration. Compared with Pipedrive, Close has more of the communication and automation tools high-volume sales teams need built in. Compared with GoHighLevel, Close is purpose-built as a fast, focused sales CRM rather than a broader platform for running an agency.

[Compare Close with HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, and other CRMs](https://close.com/compare).

#Does Close integrate with other tools?

Yes. Close integrates with tools across your sales process and supports additional connections through Zapier, Make, and its API. Close also offers an MCP server, so compatible AI tools and agents can securely work with your Close data and capabilities.

[Explore Close integrations](https://close.com/integrations) or [learn about the Close MCP server](https://close.com/integrations/close-mcp).

#Does Close have AI?

Yes. Close has two types of AI built into the CRM: Chloe and Agents. Chloe is an AI assistant that works with sellers to research leads, answer questions, run reports, update the CRM, and get things done. Agents work autonomously, taking on repeatable sales jobs like calling and qualifying leads.

[Learn more about Chloe and AI Agents in Close](https://close.com/chloe).

#Can I migrate from another CRM to Close?

Yes. You can import your existing leads, contacts, opportunities, and sales data into Close. Connect your email and calendar to get started, and use our [migration resources](https://help.close.com/docs/migration-from-another-crm) if you’re switching.

#Is Close an established and financially stable company?

Yes. Close has been building CRM software for more than 13 years, serves 11,500+ businesses, and is self-funded and profitable. Close has grown sustainably without outside investment and remains focused on building for its customers.
